scope: Classic source-backed ScrollArea and controlled ScrollBar, using native browser overflow for content. Source raster/geometry checks are not native Bedrock renderer certification.

basis.sourceMinimumThumbExtent: Not exposed in this JSON. The web default of five logical pixels is an implementation choice, not a certified native rule.

skins.implementation: Plain nearest-neighbor stretch of its one original opaque #434343 pixel. The source metadata says nineslice_size=1 on a 1x1 image; it is not treated as overlapping conventional two-sided cuts.

states.default: Original track and thumb PNGs without recoloring.
states.hover: No separate hover asset or tint was found in the inspected scroll templates and complete full-release scroll texture entries. Reuses the unchanged source.
states.disabled: Explicit disabled or zero max/page suppresses all custom actions and removes the bar from sequential focus; no invented gray or opacity filter. Same source textures remain visible if requested.
states.focus: Browser focus-visible outline is retained as a web accessibility adaptation.
states.dragging: Pointer capture plus grab/grabbing cursor only; no invented skin.
states.touch: Content uses native pan/inertia. Classic bars stay as configured; automatic Pocket fade-out/touch renderer substitution is outside this component.

geometry.scale: Positive integer GUI scale, defaults to 2. Source image pixels are never enlarged through transform:scale.
geometry.axisExtent: thumbExtent = min(trackExtent, max(minThumbSize * scale, trackExtent * pageSize / (max + pageSize))). minThumbSize defaults to 5 logical pixels.
geometry.axisPosition: thumbOffset = clamp(value,0,max) / max * (trackExtent - thumbExtent). Horizontal RTL reverses the visual position and pointer direction.
geometry.rangeUnits: max is the maximum scroll offset, not total content extent. max/pageSize/value/step are CSS pixels; scale affects the source thickness, edges and default keyboard step.
geometry.nativeMetrics: ScrollArea uses browser clientWidth/clientHeight/scrollWidth/scrollHeight and current native offsets. Fractional CSS thumb extents/offsets are retained, not independently rounded. Native Bedrock final snapping and ratio rules remain unverified.
geometry.horizontalLimit: Horizontal interaction is a browser adaptation; the original vertical source artwork is retained without rotating lighting or inventing a separate asset. No native horizontal Bedrock control certification is implied.

optional.step: CSS pixels per arrow; default 15 * scale, inspired by source scroll_speed but not a claim about native wheel units

ScrollBar.semantics: role=scrollbar, name, controls, orientation, min=0, current bounded value, max and disabled. Disabled bars have tabIndex=-1. The controlled callback must update the supplied value.
ScrollBar.keys: Axis arrows use step, PageUp/PageDown use pageSize, Home/End use bounds. Wrong-axis arrows and modifier shortcuts remain untouched. Caller onKeyDown/onPointerDown/onPointerMove run first and can prevent custom actions.
ScrollBar.pointer: Primary pointer thumb drag uses pointer capture, continues outside the bar, releases on up/cancel/lost capture/unmount. Track clicks page toward the pointer. No global pointermove/up listeners.
ScrollBar.normalization: Negative/nonfinite max/pageSize become zero; nonfinite/negative value becomes zero and is clamped to max. Zero max or page disables input. Invalid scale throws RangeError. Invalid step/minThumbSize fall back to defaults.
ScrollBar.wheel: The custom bar has a passive:false native wheel listener because it is a sibling of the viewport. CSS-pixel, line and page modes use their corresponding units; horizontal deltaX follows physical RTL direction. Only an offset change is consumed, so boundaries can chain outward. Ctrl+wheel zoom and vertical Shift+wheel are left alone. Listener is removed on cleanup.

ScrollArea.ref: Outer HTMLDivElement; viewportRef exposes the actual native overflow div.

optional.label: native viewport name; defaults to Scrollable content
optional.viewportProps: native div attributes including id, className, style, tabIndex, onScroll and onKeyDown
optional.viewportRef: React ref to the actual scrollable HTMLDivElement
optional.onScrollPositionChange: ({scrollTop,scrollLeft}) callback with actual native signed DOM offsets

ScrollArea.layout: CSS grid reserves a separate source-width bar column/row. Native scrollbars are visually hidden, while the viewport remains overflow:auto. Caller provides area dimensions through ordinary style or layout. Auto bars are hidden when their axis has no overflow; always bars remain visible and disabled when no scrolling is possible.
ScrollArea.nativeBehavior: Wheel, touch pan/inertia, focus-driven scrolling and selection use the browser. Viewport wheel/touch handlers are not intercepted or converted. Wheel over the custom scrollbar changes its controlled value and therefore the linked native viewport; boundaries continue outward normally.
ScrollArea.viewportKeys: Native focused viewport keys are preserved, including editable descendants. Only PageUp/PageDown/Home/End on a horizontal-only viewport itself are mapped to that axis. Custom scrollbar keys are separate.
ScrollArea.observation: ResizeObserver watches viewport and content; a content MutationObserver catches subtree text/children and class/style/hidden changes, image load is captured, and window resize is observed. Bar wheel and resize listeners, observers, content load listener and capture are cleaned up.
ScrollArea.ssr: No browser access or measurement occurs while rendering; measurements start in effects. Initial zero-range bars reflect the absence of server-side viewport measurements, without a hydration-dependent alternate tree.

desktopAndMobileResult.skippedReason: Desktop project does not perform the touch-only gesture; mobile CDP touchStart/touchMove/touchEnd passed.

completeRegions: Same default region with actual thumb hover
sourcePixels.reference: Independent nearest source PNG sampling with pinned raw hashes; no screenshot-generated expected baseline, masking, border exclusion or allowed differing pixels.
sourcePixels.coordinateCondition: Fixture at ordinary viewport (0,0) integer layout; no fractional translate/compositor filtering. Dynamic fractional thumb states still need their own native-frame comparison.
sourcePixels.latestStrengthenedPixelRun: 2 passed (desktop and mobile source-pixel tests); same source test now verifies all four complete regions.

interactionCoverage: Controlled keys, wrong-axis keys, track paging, explicit disabled and caller preventDefault
Real mouse capture drag outside the thumb and pointercancel
Direct native scroll/ref, native content wheel, and custom-bar hovered wheel synchronization
Native viewport PageDown/Home/End and editable child caret keys
Both-axis synchronization and horizontal-only page keys
ResizeObserver-driven content and viewport changes, auto hide and native clamp on shrink
Unmount during active capture, owned ResizeObservers disconnected, no ghost drag/page errors
verification.wheelCleanupAndSourceRepeat: 6 targeted desktop/mobile tests passed after adding bar-hover wheel, including active-capture unmount cleanup and all four complete source-pixel regions.

acceptanceLimit: Pixel comparisons certify these original-PNG web specimens only. Native Bedrock thumb minimums, engine ratio/rounding, focus/touch behavior and complete current-version screenshots remain independent acceptance gates.

rights.assets: Unchanged Mojang sample assets with original source hashes; no hand-drawn scrollbar art or fabricated state images.
